description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering timesheet search parameters in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for date range and employee number, with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: DefaultTimesheetSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filter parameters such as date range and employee number for timesheet queries.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date for the timesheet filter, if set.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date for the timesheet filter.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date for the timesheet filter, if set.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date for the timesheet filter.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.
